title: triage-apply input — the approved per-issue action list

ownedPaths.description: Concrete existing files authored into Owned Paths; glob metacharacters are refused by schema

verificationCommand.description: Exact authored command whose referenced paths, targets, and package scripts exist in the pinned checkout

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each repository-derived acceptance criterion and the Owned Paths entries that evidence it
